paragraphs.text: After Yawgmoth had taken control of many parts of the Thran Empire the enemies he had made during his exile and the Thran city-states that opposed his rise to power formed an alliance against him. This Thran Alliance consisted of dwarves , minotaur , cat-folk , elves , viashino , the barbaric humans of Gulatto Meisha and the Thran city-states Chignon , Losanon and Wington .

The Alliance won the following Thran Civil War , but at a great cost, as Yawgmoth had bombarded several cities with stonechargers and many thousands of people were killed in battle or forced to join Yawgmoth in Phyrexia , where they were twisted into mindless minions.
